headline: Revenue doubled, Street unanimous
chart_note: 52-week range: $164.27 - $236.54. Currently $224.37, near the top of its 52-week range.
why_today: Q2 FY27 revenue came in at $96.2B, up 106% YoY, with Data Center revenue of $89.0B up 117% YoY on relentless AI GPU demand. Gross margins held at 75%, and guidance calls for about $108B next quarter.
pro_1: Every one of the 29 analysts covering the stock rates it Buy or Strong Buy - rare unanimity
pro_2: Average price target of $325.23 implies roughly 45% upside from current levels
con_1: Growth this explosive eventually decelerates - the bar for 'beat and raise' keeps getting higher
con_2: At 28.5x earnings on a $5.5T market cap, any AI-spending slowdown would hit hard given the size of the bet already priced in
